# Video edit: reframe a clip to another format with Wan VACE

Places your clip, resampled to 16 frames per second, in the middle of a frame of another format and fills the new area with Wan 2.1 VACE 14B, with its sound kept or left out. Built from Comfy's template video_wan_vace_outpainting.

## Models

- [wan2.1_vace_14B_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/wan2.1_vace_14B_fp16.safetensors): Wan 2.1 VACE 14B, [Apache-2.0](https://huggingface.co/Wan-AI/Wan2.1-VACE-14B).
- [umt5_xxl_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp16.safetensors): umt5-xxl text encoder, fp16, [Apache-2.0](https://huggingface.co/google/umt5-xxl).
- [wan_2.1_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/vae/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors): Wan 2.1 VAE, [Apache-2.0](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged).

Rosesfield ships no weights. Each loader lists its file with a download link.
